basic_details.job_title: JIPMER Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 5 Project Nurse, Project Technical Support Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Jawaharlal Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education and Research (JIPMER), Puducherry, is hiring 5 people on contract for an ICMR-funded geriatric trauma project in its Department of Emergency Medicine & Trauma. The posts are 4 Project Nurse-III posts at Rs 33,600 a month and 1 Project Technical Support-II post at Rs 24,000 a month. Both amounts include 20% HRA. The posts are initially for one year and can be extended, based on performance, up to the end of the project on 30 November 2029. Project Nurse-III needs a B.Sc. how_to_apply: Applications are sent by email only, using the prescribed application form (REC-03) attached to the advertisement.
Print the application form on A4 paper and fill it in using block letters and a blue pen. Strike out the post you are not applying for.
Affix a recent passport-size photograph in the space given. Do not staple it.

Fill in your educational qualifications, previous jobs, a description of your experience (up to 500 words), any research experience or publications, and whether you are willing to do field visits. Also give your previous employers' contact details and sign the declaration.
Scan the filled form, your CV and the self-attested supporting documents into one PDF. Arrange the documents in the order of the form's checklist.
Name the PDF "Candidate name_Post-name_year_application". The notice gives the example "James_DEO_2023_application".
Email the PDF to [email protected] and write the name of the post you are applying for in the subject line.
Send the complete application by 5:00 PM on 9 November 2026.
To apply for both posts, fill in a separate application form for each post. Scan each form and send it with its own enclosures in a separate email. A valid email ID and mobile number are compulsory.
Proof of Identity (Copy of Aadhaar card/ Voter ID / Passport /Driving License)
Certificate in support of age (Tenth equivalent / High School Certificate)
Experience certificates, and PDFs of proof of work for any previous employment
Proof of prior research experience, if any
Proof of SC/ST/OBC status, where applicable
All certificates must be self-attested and attached in the order listed above.
important_instructions: Applications not in the prescribed format will not be processed or accepted. Incomplete applications, and applications from candidates who do not meet the essential criteria, are likely to be rejected without further review. Candidates may attach a CV to the application form, but an application with only a CV, without the prescribed form and certificates, will be rejected. Giving wrong or false information at any stage of selection, or canvassing of any kind, will lead to disqualification. If it is found out after engagement, it can lead to termination. The Principal Investigator may relax or change the qualification, experience and other terms and conditions. The application form asks whether you have ever been convicted by a court, or whether any criminal case, disciplinary action or vigilance enquiry is pending against you. If so, you must give the details.

Development and Evaluation of a Frailty-Triggered Co-Management Pathway for Geriatric Trauma in Indian Emergency Departments: A Pragmatic Implementation Study
Initially for one year, extendable based on performance up to the end of the project (30.11.2029)
Project Nurse-III: Rs 33,600/- per month; Project Technical Support-II: Rs 24,000/- per month (consolidated, including 20% HRA)

content_sections.heading: About JIPMER
content_sections.text: The Jawaharlal Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education and Research (JIPMER) is a medical institute at Dhanwantri Nagar, Puducherry-6. These posts belong to an externally funded research project run by its Department of Emergency Medicine & Trauma. The Project Investigator (PI) is Dr Amaravathi U, Assistant Professor, and the funding agency is ICMR.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential: B.Sc. Nursing (four-year course) with minimum second class or equivalent CGPA from a recognised university with registration in the State/Indian Nursing Council. Desirable: Experience in emergency, trauma, critical care or geriatric nursing; experience in clinical research and data collection; fluency in Tamil. Essential: 12th in Science + Diploma (MLT/DMLT / Engineering or equivalent) + Five Years Experience in relevant subject/field, OR Three Years Graduate degree in relevant subject/field + two years' experience in relevant subject. Desirable: Experience in research data management (MS Excel, REDCap/EpiData or similar software); proficiency in Tamil and English. The age limit for each post is counted as on the last date of receipt of applications. For both posts, there is a relaxation of up to 5 years for candidates with experience in a Government research organisation, as per ICMR norms. The qualification and experience must be in a relevant discipline or field and from a reputed institution or organisation. The experience must have been gained after acquiring the essential qualification. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, candidates should check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The pay for both posts is a consolidated monthly amount that includes 20% HRA. No other allowances are paid. The notice adds that the consolidated salary may change from time to time. No other allowances or facilities are given apart from the consolidated salary.

content_sections.heading: JIPMER Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Screen adults aged 60 years and above who come to the Emergency Department with trauma to check their eligibility, and assess frailty using the Clinical Frailty Scale (CFS). Obtain informed consent from patients or their legally acceptable representatives (LAR) as per the approved protocol, in Tamil and English. Activate and coordinate the frailty-triggered co-management pathway with the emergency, trauma and geriatric teams, and record time-stamped process measures. Perform daily delirium screening (CAM-ICU) and record clinical data in the Case Record Forms. Provide counselling on transitional care before discharge and make warm referrals. Carry out the community contact 7 to 14 days after discharge and the 90-day structured follow-up by telephone and field/home visits. Work in rotational shifts, including nights, Sundays and holidays, as required by the project. Any other project-related work assigned by the PI from time to time. Data entry, cleaning and management of the study database; maintain Case Record Forms and study records. Extract time-stamped process data from the Hospital Information System; maintain follow-up schedules and tracking logs. Assist with telephone follow-up, report preparation, procurement records and other administrative work for the project. Any other project-related work assigned by the PI from time to time. For both posts, the duties listed are indicative and not exhaustive. Project staff must carry out any work the PI assigns in the interest of the project, including shift duty, field visits and administrative tasks. Refusing assigned work will be treated as unsatisfactory performance and may lead to termination of the engagement without notice. The application form says the project involves field visits for patient follow-up in Puducherry and neighbouring districts.

Affix a recent passport-size photograph in the space given. Do not staple it. Fill in your educational qualifications, previous jobs, a description of your experience (up to 500 words), any research experience or publications, and whether you are willing to do field visits. Also give your previous employers' contact details and sign the declaration. Scan the filled form, your CV and the self-attested supporting documents into one PDF. Email the PDF to [email protected] and write the name of the post you are applying for in the subject line. Send the complete application by 5:00 PM on 9 November 2026 . To apply for both posts, fill in a separate application form for each post. Scan each form and send it with its own enclosures in a separate email. A valid email ID and mobile number are compulsory. Proof of Identity (Copy of Aadhaar card/ Voter ID / Passport /Driving License) Certificate in support of age (Tenth equivalent / High School Certificate) Degrees/Diplomas (self-attested photocopies of educational qualifications) Experience certificates, and PDFs of proof of work for any previous employment Proof of prior research experience, if any Proof of SC/ST/OBC status, where applicable Any others (if relevant; specify) CV All certificates must be self-attested and attached in the order listed above.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applicants will be shortlisted using the details in their application, their CV and the documentary proof they provide. The list of eligible candidates will also be displayed on the JIPMER website. Final selection will be based on the CV, the application and a written test/interview. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for a written test and/or interview. If there are a very large number of applications, stricter criteria than those listed may be used to decide eligibility. The Project Investigator's decision will be final. After the application forms are evaluated, the notice lists these stages: The interview may be held in person or by videoconferencing, at the discretion of the Principal Investigator. For a video interview, candidates are responsible for having a suitable device (computer, laptop or mobile) with audio and camera and a good internet connection. The date and time of the interview will be announced one week in advance. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in JIPMER Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 5 vacancies in total: 4 for Project Nurse-III and 1 for Project Technical Support-II.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for JIPMER Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Complete applications must be sent by email by 5:00 PM on 9 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the JIPMER Project Nurse-III post?
faq.answer: You need a B.Sc. Nursing (four-year course) with minimum second class or equivalent CGPA from a recognised university, with registration in the State/Indian Nursing Council. For Project Technical Support-II, you need 12th in Science + Diploma (MLT/DMLT / Engineering or equivalent) + five years' experience, OR a three-year graduate degree in a relevant subject/field + two years' experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for JIPMER Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: For Project Nurse-III, the age must not exceed 35 years. For Project Technical Support-II, the limit is 30 years. Age is counted as on the last date of receipt of applications. Candidates with experience in a Government research organisation get a relaxation of up to 5 years, as per ICMR norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the JIPMER project posts?
faq.answer: Project Nurse-III pays Rs 33,600/- per month (Rs 28,000 + 20% HRA). Project Technical Support-II pays Rs 24,000/- per month (Rs 20,000 + 20% HRA). Both are consolidated amounts.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA or any other allowance paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: No. The 20% HRA is already included in the consolidated amount, and no other allowances are payable.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for JIPMER Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Email the filled application form, your CV and your self-attested documents, scanned into one PDF, to [email protected]. Name the PDF "Candidate name_Post-name_year_application" and write the post name in the email subject line.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the JIPMER project posts?
faq.answer: Applicants are shortlisted using their application, CV and documents. Shortlisted candidates are then called for a written test, a skill test and an interview. The interview may be held in person or by videoconferencing, and its date will be announced one week in advance.

faq.question: Q9. Is the JIPMER Project Nurse-III job permanent?
faq.answer: No. Both posts are purely on contract for an externally sponsored project and give no claim to a regular post at JIPMER. The engagement is initially for one year and can be extended, based on performance, up to 30 November 2029.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply for both posts in JIPMER Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes. Fill in a separate application form for each post and send each one, with its enclosures, in a separate email.
